'''Sofi Beroya''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a member of [[Clan Beroya]]. She was friends with [[Arla Ha'rangir]], who she had romantic feelings for. When Arla joined the [[Hidden Chain]], Sofi started to pine for her, and hoped to convince [[Mandalore the Avenger]] that she could bring Arla back over to her [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|faction]], though others suspected that she would simply run away with her.<ref name="Mail" />
